evidence_quote: This 12-week randomized, placebo-controlled trial aimed to improve metabolic health through increasing distal SCFA production while inhibiting proteolytic fermentation using a fiber supplement that increased distal SCFA production in vitro.
rationale: The trial examines dietary fiber, microbial fermentation, and metabolic health in adults with overweight/obesity. It does not address tumor progression, cancer biomarkers, or cancer treatments.
